meta.source: Original system modeled on Material Design 3 conventions. Colour roles generated from the user palette ef476f, ffd166, 06d6a0, 118ab2, 073b4c with HCT tonal palettes and the M3 light/dark tone mapping.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Key action colour: filled button, active switch track, checked checkbox and radio, text and outlined button labels on `surface`, active tab indicator. Text on it uses `on-primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills (filled button label, switch handle when on, check mark).

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Fill for FABs, selected cards and other prominent but lower-emphasis brand surfaces. Text on it uses `on-primary-container`.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-container`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting accent: focus ring colour and secondary icons or labels on `surface`. Text on it uses `on-secondary`.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary` fills.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Fill for tonal buttons, selected chips and list rows, and the navigation active indicator. Text on it uses `on-secondary-container`.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary-container`.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Contrasting accent that balances primary and secondary: highlights, ratings, informational callouts. Text on it uses `on-tertiary`.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `tertiary` fills.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Fill for tertiary-accented surfaces such as an alternate FAB or a highlighted card. Text on it uses `on-tertiary-container`.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `tertiary-container`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, error icons and the error outline of text fields on `surface`; fill for badges. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone. Fill use takes `on-error`.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `error` fills.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Fill for error banners and destructive confirmations. Text on it uses `on-error-container`.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `error-container`.

tokens.name: primary-fixed
tokens.usage: Primary tone that stays the same in light and dark: use for surfaces that must not change with the theme. Text on it uses `on-primary-fixed`.

tokens.name: primary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Slightly deeper `primary-fixed`; use for the stronger element on a fixed surface. Text on it uses `on-primary-fixed`.

tokens.name: on-primary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-fixed` and `primary-fixed-dim`.

tokens.name: on-primary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons on `primary-fixed` and `primary-fixed-dim`.

tokens.name: secondary-fixed
tokens.usage: Secondary tone that stays the same in light and dark. Text on it uses `on-secondary-fixed`.

tokens.name: secondary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Slightly deeper `secondary-fixed`. Text on it uses `on-secondary-fixed`.

tokens.name: on-secondary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary-fixed` and `secondary-fixed-dim`.

tokens.name: on-secondary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons on `secondary-fixed` and `secondary-fixed-dim`.

tokens.name: tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: Tertiary tone that stays the same in light and dark. Text on it uses `on-tertiary-fixed`.

tokens.name: tertiary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Slightly deeper `tertiary-fixed`. Text on it uses `on-tertiary-fixed`.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `tertiary-fixed` and `tertiary-fixed-dim`.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons on `tertiary-fixed` and `tertiary-fixed-dim`.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the app. Text on it uses `on-background`.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Default text on `background`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default ground for screens, sheets, top app bars and outlined cards. Text on it uses `on-surface` or `on-surface-variant`.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every `surface` and `surface-container-*` tone: headlines, body, list headlines.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Darkest surface in light theme (stays at the page tone in dark): scroll-behind areas and dimmed regions. Text on it uses `on-surface`.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Brightest surface in both themes: elevated panels that should lift off a dim background. Text on it uses `on-surface`.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lowest surface tone: recessed wells and navigation drawers behind content. Text on it uses `on-surface`.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Elevated card and bottom-sheet ground. Text on it uses `on-surface`.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Navigation bar, search bar and scrolled top app bar ground. Text on it uses `on-surface`.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialog, menu and date-picker ground. Text on it uses `on-surface` and `on-surface-variant`.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Filled card, filled text field, switch-off track and disabled-fill ground. Text on it uses `on-surface` and `on-surface-variant`.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Alternate ground for inactive component fills such as tab strips. Text on it uses `on-surface-variant`.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons: supporting text, inactive navigation items, input labels and leading icons on `surface` and `surface-container-*` tones.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: outlined button and text field borders, unchecked checkbox and radio borders, switch-off track border. Holds 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-container-highest`.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the border of outlined cards. Below 3:1 on `surface`, so never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar and tooltip ground. Text on it uses `inverse-on-surface`.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on `inverse-surface`.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text on `inverse-surface` (snackbar action).

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Tint laid over surfaces to show elevation; equal to `primary`. Not used for text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and sheets, painted at 32% opacity. Never used for text.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Colour of elevation shadows; the `elevation-*` tokens already embed it.

tokens.name: ocean-blue
tokens.usage: Source colour for primary (HCT hue 230). Decorative: illustration, charts, covers and brand moments. White text on it is 4.0:1, so it is large-text only and never carries body copy; use `primary` for interface.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Source colour for secondary (HCT hue 169). Decorative: illustration, charts, covers. `dark-teal` text on it is 6.4:1 if a label is unavoidable; interface labels use `on-secondary-container` on `secondary-container`.

tokens.name: golden-pollen
tokens.usage: Source colour for tertiary (HCT hue 87). Decorative: illustration, charts, covers. `dark-teal` text on it is 8.4:1; interface labels use `on-tertiary-container` on `tertiary-container`.

tokens.name: bubblegum-pink
tokens.usage: Source colour for error (HCT hue 10). Decorative only; neither white nor `dark-teal` text reaches 4.5:1 on it. Interface errors use `error`, the same hue at tone 40 (light) and 80 (dark), which passes.

tokens.name: dark-teal
tokens.usage: Source colour for neutral and neutral-variant (HCT hue 228, chroma 6/8). Decorative ink; interface text uses `on-surface`.

styles.usage: Badge counts, overlines, captions on dense UI.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Default UI copy, list supporting text, dialog body.

styles.name: body-small

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Flush edges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge gaps and tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a button icon and its label; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact padding in list items and text buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default content padding, card padding, screen margin on compact widths.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large-bar padding and comfortable list leading space.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, dialog padding, screen margin on medium widths.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Minimum visual control height; icon-button size.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top app bar height; large section gaps.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed surfaces and sheets docked to an edge.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Snackbar, filled text field top corners, checkbox (2px inside).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small menus.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, small FAB, text-field outline.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: FAB, large cards, bottom-sheet minimum.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, large FAB, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero surfaces and expressive feature tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, switches, icon buttons, navigation indicators: fully rounded ends.

shadow.note: Elevation levels 0–5. Surfaces also gain a tonal tint from the `surface-container-*` ladder; shadow alone never carries hierarchy.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Flat: filled and outlined cards, text buttons.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Elevated card, elevated button, scrolled top app bar.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Hovered elevated card, menus, navigation bar when floating.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: FAB, dialog, snackbar, bottom sheet.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: Dragged items and pressed FAB lift.

tokens.name: elevation-5
tokens.usage: Reserved for drag-and-drop previews.

opacity.note: State layers: paint the content colour (`currentColor`) over a component at these opacities.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: State layer when a pointer hovers a control.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: State layer when a control has keyboard focus (plus the focus ring).

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: State layer while a control is pressed.

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: State layer while an item is dragged.

tokens.name: state-disabled-content
tokens.usage: Opacity of text and icons in a disabled control.

tokens.name: state-disabled-container
tokens.usage: Opacity of the fill and outline of a disabled control.

tokens.name: state-scrim
tokens.usage: Opacity of `scrim` behind dialogs and sheets.
